create_IterativeRefinementGenerator: create an IterativeRefinementGenerator with a target dictionary, eos penalty, max iterations, and beam size
generate_translations_with_IterativeRefi: generate iterative refinement translations from a batched dataset using the IterativeRefinementGenerator
run_generate_batched_itr: run generate_batched_itr to iterate over a batched dataset and yield individual translations
run_generate_method: run the generate method on models and a sample to produce finalized hypotheses with iterative refinement
rerank_hypotheses_with_reranker: rerank finalized hypotheses using a reranker model to compute normalized probability scores
